verdict.rationale: Munito AI documents separate EU and US hosts that keep processing in their region, lists regions per model, and offers routing to its European compute cloud or the customer's own cloud. Paired with zero data retention, this gives the user a direct choice of data residency. Missing for 10: in-depth residency documentation (exact endpoints, guarantees, regions beyond EU/US), per-model region-availability detail, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: The EU and US hosts keep processing in their region.
Each model with its context, its regions and its price for each service tier.
It then sends the request to Munito Compute Cloud, which sits in front of a pixel map of Europe, or to your own cloud.
Private by default, zero data retention.
